intro.title: 6 Mukhi Rudraksha Mala
intro.descriptionHtml: Our collection of six mukhi Mars power mala is strung together with authentic and premium quality 6 mukhi Rudraksha beads. The wearer of the 6 mukhi Mars power mala is blessed with youthful appearance and sensory control. Moreover, this pious mala helps to pacify the malefic of planet Mars and bestows the qualities of being fearless, spontaneous and gives courage to face any situation. This mala is recommended to be worn by people having mangal dosha in their natal chart.
